rules.title: SSC leave encashment does not accumulate in last engagement year
rules.notes: Retain annual leave and terminal leave entitlements separately.

rules.title: Retirement payment responsibility split
rules.notes: Routing metadata should be updated if departmental responsibility changes.

rules.title: DSOP annual statement is a separate record
rules.notes: Do not treat payslip deductions as a substitute for the annual statement.

rules.title: Increment audit needs previous basic and increment date

calculation.formula: compare current basic-pay cell with applicable next cell

rules.notes: The handbook summary does not replace the applicable pay-matrix/order.

rules.title: Partial furlough month requires special treatment
rules.notes: Do not automatically halve the allowance without checking the exact period rule.

rules.title: Long course transport allowance requires course-duration check
rules.notes: Course rules are sensitive to duration, location, and free transport.

rules.title: Field HRA rate basis
rules.notes: Require SPR and accommodation facts before selecting a rate.

rules.title: Reserved accommodation exception requires location classification
rules.notes: Do not generalize the FAQ exception to all government accommodation.

rules.title: Same-station mess and family arrangement
rules.notes: FAQ says HRA is not admissible unless the required certification is provided.

rules.title: 177A route depends on actual family residence
rules.authority: Travel Regulations Rule 177A as explained by PCDA(O) FAQ
rules.notes: Capture the residence that existed on the journey date.

rules.title: 177B destination and block tracking
rules.authority: Travel Regulations Rule 177B as explained by PCDA(O) FAQ
rules.notes: Do not infer alternate-year eligibility without the officer's prior LTC history.

rules.title: 177C does not replace family LTC analysis
rules.authority: Travel Regulations Rule 177C as explained by PCDA(O) FAQ
rules.notes: Track whether the officer or family used another LTC entitlement.

rules.title: Study-leave family origin depends on where family stays
rules.authority: Travel Regulations Rule 177D as explained by PCDA(O) FAQ
rules.notes: Apply the relevant fare ceiling and residence condition.

rules.title: Private vehicle LTC restriction
rules.authority: Travel Regulations Rule 176(e)(ii) as explained by PCDA(O) FAQ
rules.notes: Use an exception only when explicitly authorized.

rules.title: LTC boarding pass loss
rules.notes: Prompt for permitted substitute evidence only if current procedure allows it.

rules.title: Return-journey anchor for claim deadline
rules.notes: Calendar-day handling should be implemented and tested explicitly.

rules.title: Advance-drawn claim deadline anchor
rules.notes: Apply to the relevant claim type and controlling procedure.

rules.title: Controlling officer submission
rules.notes: This is workflow metadata, not proof that a claim is admissible.

rules.title: PDM journey requires movement evidence
rules.notes: Exact documents depend on the movement and claimant.

rules.title: Family air entitlement follows officer entitlement class
rules.notes: Route and direct-journey conditions still apply.

rules.title: MSP is excluded from LTC leave-encashment base
rules.notes: This is duplicated intentionally as a calculation guard for the DA/MSP domain.

rules.title: Component variance requires event explanation
rules.authority: PayslipMax implementation policy informed by handbook
rules.notes: This is a product rule for explainable anomaly detection, not a legal entitlement.

rules.title: LTC purpose and rule must be recorded
rules.notes: Prevents applying 177A, 177B, 177C, or 177D logic interchangeably.

rules.title: LTC family scope is rule-specific
rules.notes: Spouse, children, parents, and other dependents do not share identical scope under every rule.

rules.title: LTC journey cannot be approved from ticket presence alone
rules.notes: Ticket proves travel evidence, not entitlement.

rules.title: Journey completion evidence is required for settlement
rules.notes: Apply permitted alternatives only under current procedure.

rules.title: Fare comparison must use the authorized route
rules.notes: Do not calculate the cheapest or fastest route as automatically admissible.

rules.title: En-route stay is a separate condition
rules.notes: A connection does not automatically authorize a break in journey.

rules.title: Sanction, journey, and settlement records must share a claim ID
rules.notes: This prevents cross-claim evidence contamination.

rules.title: Claim amendments must preserve original submission
rules.notes: Do not overwrite the original audit record.

rules.title: Digital evidence needs integrity metadata
rules.notes: Technical integrity does not establish entitlement by itself.

rules.title: PDM movement date controls claim period
rules.notes: Different components may occur on different dates.

rules.title: Old accommodation retention is a separate fact
rules.notes: Verify exact page/reference and current retention rules before implementation.

rules.title: Accommodation change triggers HRA re-evaluation
rules.notes: Do not apply the previous month's HRA unchanged.

rules.title: CEA duplicate payment check
rules.notes: Retain separate receipts/claims while enforcing annual limits.
mandatory_paperwork: Original Hotel Tax Invoice / Cash Memo

rules.title: Unresolved high-impact variance must block definitive advice
rules.notes: This protects against confident outputs from incomplete context.

rules.title: Full-pay commissioned service counts for increments
rules.authority: SRO 12(E) dated 03-05-2017 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Apply exclusions only from the governing rule.

rules.title: Only one annual increment date applies
rules.authority: SRO 12(E) dated 03-05-2017 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Selection depends on appointment, promotion, or upgradation timing.

rules.title: Forfeiture affects future increments only
rules.authority: Rule 41 Pay and Allowances Regulations as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Current pay on forfeiture date is not retroactively changed by this rule.

rules.title: Increment date follows appointment timing
rules.authority: GoI MoD OM dated 26-02-2019 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: The complementary 02-Jul to 01-Jan window maps to 01-Jul; test boundary dates.

rules.title: Pay-matrix increment moves vertically within level
rules.authority: Army Officers Pay Rules 2017 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Promotion or upgradation uses separate fixation logic.

rules.title: NPA eligibility is restricted by medical appointment
rules.authority: Rule 171 Pay and Allowances Regulations as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Require appointment and rank evidence.

rules.title: NPA rate and cap

calculation.formula: NPA = 20% of basic pay subject to basic pay + MSP + NPA <= 237500

rules.authority: GoI MoD letter dated 28-09-2017 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Current NPA orders should be checked before payment advice.

rules.title: NPA is not calculated on MSP and is excluded from HRA base
rules.authority: GoI MoD letters cited by handbook
rules.notes: NPA may count for DA, pension, and other allowances unless their orders say otherwise.

rules.title: Transport allowance rates from 1 July 2017
rules.authority: GoI MoD letter dated 15-09-2017 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: City list and current orders control eligibility.

rules.title: Transport allowance standard rate from 1 July 2017
rules.authority: GoI MoD letter dated 15-09-2017 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Confirm city classification from the applicable annexure.

rules.title: Level 14 and above transport allowance rate
rules.authority: GoI MoD transport instructions as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Official-car entitlement and competent-authority certification are required.

rules.title: Transport allowance requires no government commuting transport
rules.authority: GoI MoD transport instructions as cited by handbook
rules.notes: The allowance compensates commuting expenditure.

rules.title: Double transport allowance for specified disabilities
rules.authority: GoI MoD/MoF instructions cited by handbook
rules.notes: Partially blind personnel are specifically excluded from the double-rate provision in the handbook.

rules.title: CEA claim must identify the academic session
rules.notes: Do not use financial year as a substitute without authority.

rules.title: Hostel subsidy claim must distinguish hostel status from school status
rules.notes: A school bonafide certificate alone may not prove hostel residence.

rules.title: Twin and divyang classifications must be child-specific
rules.notes: Do not apply the enhanced rate to the non-qualifying twin.

rules.title: SPR is a selected residence record, not merely a postal address
rules.notes: Preserve the declaration instrument and date.

rules.title: Field posting HRA review needs posting classification
rules.notes: A unit name or user-entered label is not enough.

rules.title: LTC journey record needs leave linkage
rules.notes: Keep leave dates and journey dates independently auditable.

rules.title: LTC destination must be recorded before fare evaluation
rules.notes: Do not infer destination from the most expensive ticket.

rules.title: Journey evidence should cover every claimed leg
rules.notes: A single ticket does not necessarily prove completion of all legs.

rules.title: Unclaimed journey segment should not be included in reimbursement
rules.notes: Maintain the full itinerary separately from claimed segments.

rules.title: Pay component label changes need alias history
rules.notes: Prevents false component additions caused by payroll label changes.

rules.title: Zero-value component may still be an active entitlement state
rules.notes: Do not equate zero with absence of entitlement.

rules.title: Rate lookup must include component identity
rules.notes: Similar labels must not share a rate implicitly.

rules.title: Rate table must not overlap for the same key
rules.notes: Overlaps require an explicit authority-precedence resolution.

rules.title: Rate revision needs supersession metadata
rules.notes: Upload date is not an effective date.

rules.title: Promotion event should precede promotion-fixation evaluation
rules.notes: Use promotion order date and effective date distinctly.

rules.title: Posting event should precede SPR evaluation
rules.notes: Use POSIN as the deadline anchor when that is the applicable field.

rules.title: Leave event must be resolved before transport audit
rules.notes: Transport outcomes differ by leave type and full-month coverage.

rules.title: Duplicate claim detection key
rules.authority: PayslipMax implementation policy informed by handbook
rules.notes: Allow legitimate separate components to remain separate.

rules.title: CEA and hostel claims need distinct component keys
rules.notes: CEA and hostel subsidy may be concurrent; identical duplicate claims are not.

rules.title: Current controlling authority overrides handbook summary
rules.notes: Expose the conflict in the audit result.

rules.title: FAQ answer without cited authority is non-final
rules.notes: The FAQ remains useful for questions and workflow but not final legal certainty.

rules.title: Rule result must record engine and pack versions
rules.notes: Enables reproducibility when rules change.

rules.title: Rule result must record rejected alternatives
rules.notes: Useful when authority or dates disqualify a candidate rule.

rules.title: Deadline alert severity increases near due date
rules.authority: PayslipMax implementation policy informed by FAQ deadlines
rules.notes: Product alert thresholds are configurable and not legal deadlines.

rules.title: Missing evidence alert should name the remedy
rules.notes: Avoid generic alerts that do not help the officer act.

rules.title: Rule applicability requires all mandatory conditions
rules.notes: Do not treat a partial match as entitlement.

rules.title: Contradictory context blocks automatic calculation
rules.notes: Example: field posting and peace accommodation facts with overlapping effective dates.

rules.title: Allowance cessation needs an effective end date
rules.notes: Publication date alone cannot end a payroll component.

rules.title: Allowance restart is a new event
rules.notes: Do not merge separated payment periods into one uninterrupted entitlement.

rules.title: Corrected claim must recalculate settlement
rules.notes: Preserve the prior settlement for audit comparison.

rules.title: Partial claim payment needs component-level explanation
rules.notes: Do not show only the net amount to the user.

rules.title: Source comparison must preserve document edition
rules.notes: A newer FAQ and older handbook should not be flattened into one undated fact.

rules.title: Short source snippet is optional and bounded
rules.notes: Prefer paraphrase and page reference; avoid reproducing long passages.

rules.title: Month-end boundary needs explicit timezone
rules.notes: Use the officer's relevant administrative timezone for alerts.

rules.title: Evidence can support a rule without proving every condition
rules.notes: A posting order may prove posting, not accommodation or family residence.

rules.title: Re-evaluation must identify changed inputs
rules.notes: Useful when a later document changes an earlier possible-entitlement result.

rules.title: Alert should close when required evidence is accepted
rules.notes: Retain alert history and prior state.

rules.title: Qualification Allowance eligible appointments
rules.authority: Pay and Allowances Handbook 2023; cited MoD/CGDA orders
rules.notes: Rates increase by 25% each time DA rises by 50%, subject to current authority.

rules.title: Qualification Grant abolished as separate allowance
rules.authority: GoI MoF resolution dated 06-07-2017 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Handbook notes that post-7th-CPC MoD orders were awaited; do not pay automatically.

rules.title: Technical Allowance Tier I eligibility
rules.authority: MoD technical allowance orders cited by handbook
rules.notes: Young Officers' Course or equivalent is referenced; confirm current course list.

rules.title: Technical Allowance Tier II rank condition
rules.authority: MoD technical allowance orders cited by handbook
rules.notes: Maximum one course from each tier is stated.

rules.title: Technical Allowance course count limit
rules.authority: MoD technical allowance orders cited by handbook
rules.notes: Course must relate directly to duties and satisfy prescribed conditions.

rules.title: NSG deputation allowance
rules.authority: MHA letter dated 03-08-2017 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Other types of pay are excluded from the stated base.

rules.title: Ration Money Allowance requires no free ration in kind
rules.authority: DSR Rule 174(B) and SAPCS letter dated 01-04-2022 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Actual journey periods are excluded when TA/DA is payable.

rules.title: Ration Allowance cannot overlap daily allowance or free messing
rules.authority: SAPCS letter dated 01-04-2022 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Store the overlapping periods for audit.

rules.title: Ration Allowance cessation should follow grant
rules.authority: SAPCS letter dated 01-04-2022 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Prevents overpayment after return or restoration of free ration.

rules.title: Retirement leave encashment maximum
rules.authority: Pay and Allowances Handbook 2023; MoD order cited
rules.notes: Require year-wise accumulated leave and retirement/release Part II Order.

rules.title: DSOP final payment at retirement
rules.notes: Keep the final DSOP account separate from monthly contributions.

rules.title: DSOP subscription stop window
rules.authority: MoD letter dated 04-03-1986 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Confirm applicability to the officer's release category.

rules.title: SSC terminal benefits categories
rules.notes: Each benefit has separate evidence and limits.

rules.title: SSC leave encashment maximum
rules.notes: Last-year accumulation and terminal leave rules require separate treatment.

rules.title: Source freshness must be tracked for monetary rules
rules.notes: A 2023 handbook rate should not be assumed current.

rules.title: Rate source must identify issuing authority
rules.notes: PCDA(O) implementation guidance and controlling government orders are not interchangeable.

rules.title: Missing effective end date does not prove continuing validity
rules.notes: Open-ended records need current-source verification.

rules.title: Correction payslip needs linkage to corrected period
rules.authority: PayslipMax implementation policy informed by handbook
rules.notes: Do not count correction amounts as a new recurring component.

rules.title: Arrear period and payment month must be separate
rules.notes: This prevents false month-over-month anomalies.

rules.title: Recovery period and recovery month must be separate
rules.notes: The recovery may relate to a prior pay or allowance period.

rules.title: Component sign must be validated
rules.notes: OCR can turn a negative adjustment into a positive credit.

rules.title: Evidence supersession must be explicit
rules.notes: Never silently replace an evidence document used in a past evaluation.

rules.title: Evidence rejection must retain reason
rules.notes: Useful for resubmission workflows and auditability.

rules.title: Claim resubmission must preserve original claim identity
rules.notes: Avoid treating a resubmission as a duplicate new journey.

rules.title: Claim rejection and payment recovery are different outcomes
rules.notes: This distinction affects alerts and financial history.

rules.title: Rule evaluation should be reproducible from a snapshot
rules.notes: A later rate update must not alter a historical audit silently.

rules.title: Historical evaluation should use historical rule validity
rules.notes: Use effective dates, not current upload state.

rules.title: Source conflict should be visible to the user
rules.notes: Do not hide uncertainty behind a single synthesized answer.

rules.title: DA rate shown for 1 January 2023
rules.notes: Historical handbook rate only; verify later revisions for later pay periods.

rules.title: DA review dates
rules.notes: The handbook states DA is sanctioned twice yearly; current rates must be loaded separately.

rules.title: DA eligible base components
rules.notes: Special pay and other types of pay are excluded from this stated base.

rules.title: DA during leave
rules.notes: Leave without pay and allowances is excluded by the handbook statement.

rules.title: Kit Maintenance Allowance subsumed
rules.authority: GoI MoD letter dated 16-11-2017 cited by handbook
rules.notes: Verify current dress-allowance rate and eligibility separately.

rules.title: R&H matrix values in 2023 handbook
rules.authority: MoD DMA letter dated 21-04-2022 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Historical/source-derived rate; area and category eligibility remain separate.

rules.title: R&H matrix values in 2023 handbook
rules.authority: MoD DMA letter dated 21-04-2022 as cited by handbook
rules.notes: Historical/source-derived rate; do not use without notified-area mapping.

rules.title: R&H is not concurrent with listed field allowances
rules.notes: Check any later order or specific exception before stopping payment.

rules.title: Tough Location Allowance rates by category
rules.notes: Requires SC(RL)A area classification and current rate verification.

rules.title: TLA escalation trigger
rules.notes: Verify the applicable notification and effective date before calculation.

rules.title: Officer and family movement dates may differ
rules.notes: Do not reject a family claim merely because dates differ.

rules.title: Family residence at SPR requires SPR linkage
rules.notes: SPR is not established by a ticket destination alone.

rules.title: Baggage dispatch date is part of the move record
rules.notes: Supports claim period and evidence matching.

rules.title: Journey cancellation must close or amend dependent claims
rules.notes: Cancellation is a state transition, not deletion.

rules.title: Travel claim duplicate detection includes journey dates
rules.notes: Same claimant and type can legitimately recur for different journeys.

rules.title: Fare evidence must match claimed mode
rules.notes: Do not substitute rail, air, road, or private transport rules.

rules.title: Journey leg changes require route history
rules.notes: Route changes may alter fare entitlement and evidence requirements.

rules.title: Family LTC visit to field station needs rule-title selection
rules.authority: Travel Regulations as explained by PCDA(O) FAQ
rules.notes: The same visit facts may map to different rule titles depending on the journey pattern.

rules.title: LTC return journey deadline is independently auditable
rules.notes: A late return requires authority review rather than silent extension.

rules.title: Travel settlement may appear as a later payslip adjustment
rules.notes: Do not flag a settlement adjustment as unexplained pay without linkage.

rules.title: Travel recovery should link to original advance
rules.notes: Supports explanation of deductions and interest.

rules.title: Page reference confidence must be recorded
rules.notes: Use printed page and PDF page after manual confirmation.

rules.title: Cited authority should be retained verbatim as metadata only
rules.notes: Do not reproduce lengthy order text.

rules.title: Effective date is inclusive unless authority says otherwise
rules.notes: Confirm boundary convention from the controlling order.

rules.title: Event date and payment date must not be substituted
rules.notes: Important for arrears, allowance starts, and recoveries.

rules.title: Rate fallback must be explicit
rules.notes: Never fall back to nearest rank, station, or date without authority.

rules.title: Rate table import must preserve source row identity
rules.notes: Enables later correction without losing traceability.

rules.title: Claim period must align with journey period
rules.notes: Request correction or explanation before calculation.

rules.title: Evidence date must fall within or support the claim period
rules.notes: Some orders are issued before or after the journey; retain an explanation.

rules.title: LTC year and journey date must be stored separately
rules.notes: Avoid inferring year from claim submission date.

rules.title: HRA evaluation must use accommodation status on the effective date
rules.notes: Require current payroll treatment before calculating partial-month results.

rules.title: Academic-year rate changes need period split
rules.notes: Do not retroactively apply a new rate without its authority.

rules.title: Manual overrides require reason and approver
rules.notes: Manual override must not mutate the original deterministic result.

rules.title: Incomplete context should produce questions, not assumptions
rules.notes: This is a safety control for the assistant layer.
